clips.title: The story
paras: Apprentice Kryten has enchanted the agate you brought him from the Boulderfist shaman. Touched to a pedestal at the foot of the tower, it will wake the tower's defenses. Before you leave, he sends you to Skuerto for the rest.

Kryten hands you the enchanted gem. He explains that touching it to a pedestal at the foot of the tower will wake the tower's defenses, and that you should use it when you are ready to go in after the rest of Trelane's items. He will await your return at the camp. First, speak to Skuerto, who will fill in whatever else you need to know.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you are, friend. The gem only needs to be pressed against one of the pedestals near the base of the tower to activate its defenses. Use it when you're ready to enter the tower and find Trelane's remaining items.
Good luck to you. I'll be awaiting your return here at the camp. Oh, and speak to Skuerto before you leave. He'll give you the rest of the details you'll need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If there are no other delays, how about we get started?
